title: Deformation Quantization of Distributed Inference: The Convex Case
content: Using modest spectral graph theory, we show that under the assumption of convexity, beliefs will diffuse towards consensus. Our toy model captures opinion dynamics in a manner sensitive to the order of belief--updates amongst agents in a network. To accomplish this, we introduce a first-order deformation of the classical observable algebra and study the resulting non-commutative correction through an explicit graph bracket. We include a concrete computation alongside some code in the appendix.
